titulo: Your TV remote was invented to shut the ads up

frases.texto: Your TV remote was invented to shut the ads up.
The man who ran Zenith hated commercials so much, he thought television would die.
He wanted a button that could mute them from the couch.
The first one was a cable across the floor, and people tripped on it.
It changed the channel. The ad kept talking.
So the next one was a flashlight. Aim it at the corner, and the sound dies.
Sunshine hit the screen, and the channels spun on their own.
It did not kill the ads. It taught you to leave them.
Before the remote, you were stuck, because getting up was too much.
One click, and you were gone, so the ads learned to grab you.
That button is in your phone now. The app is in the link in my bio.
Send this to that friend who still yells at the ads.
